SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM schools_ext
INNER JOIN satscores_ext ON schools_ext.CDSCode = satscores_ext.cds
WHERE satscores_ext.AvgScrMath > 400
AND schools_ext.Virtual = 'F';

SELECT sc."CDSCode"
FROM "frpm_ext" fe
JOIN "schools_core" sc ON fe."CDSCode" = sc."CDSCode"
WHERE fe."Enrollment (K-12)" > 500;
